_note: Short Ibrahim «die Götzen» 19.11.2026: s4d/s4e en without additions (al-Anbiya 60, 63: يذكرهم / بل فعله كبيرهم), names local (Abraham).

en.s4d: Some of them said: We heard a young man talking about them. His name is Ibrahim.
en.s4e: They asked him: Did you do this, Ibrahim? Ibrahim said: Rather, the biggest of them did it. So ask them, if they can speak.

fr.s4d: Certains dirent : Nous avons entendu un jeune homme parler d'elles. Il s'appelle Ibrahim.
